snippet.title: His Fragile Mind (trailer)
snippet.description:
A trailer of my new RPGMaker game called "His Fragile Mind".
It will take me a little bit more to finish it, so I didn't make any page for it, but I think I can upload the trailer already~.

Hopefully, the game will be out in 2022! Stay tuned!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Music by Nemi: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo4Ic018vvx78MKS8yU9P4g

Old movie overlay: https://youtu.be/su121IWji9o
